content: NEWSEQUENTIALID() vs NEWID(): NEWID() generates non-sequential GUIDs causing page splits/fragmentation when clustered; NEWSEQUENTIALID() generates ordered GUIDs reducing fragmentation and random IO. Widely-cited alternative best practice: don't cluster on GUID at all, use a narrow bigint IDENTITY as clustered key + nonclustered unique constraint on the GUID. SPEC.md already specifies NEWSEQUENTIALID() as the clustered PK default, consistent with the primary recommendation.
